The project provides support to public and private stakeholders to create an enabling policy and regulatory environment, strengthen capacities, improve the bankability of projects and develop sustainable and inclusive value chains. Its areas of work include strategy, policy and regulatory frameworks; private sector cooperation and finance; capacity strengthening, research and development; sustainability and just transition; and battery value chains. To respond flexibly and efficiently to the diverse and evolving demand for specialised expertise, GIZ intends to establish a framework agreement with an expert pool. title-proc.eng: Assignment for services related to ecological measures

description-proc.fra: La mission concerne la mise en œuvre de mesures écologiques (telles que l’inventaire, la translocation et le suivi de certaines espèces animales), la coordination des activités liées aux abattages et diverses prestations supplémentaires. Les actions nécessaires concernant les mesures écologiques de réduction des nuisances pour la population de muscardin dans la zone du projet DBFM R0 Nord – Zone Zaventem doivent être réalisées avant les abattages et les travaux d’exécution pour la réaménagement de l’autoroute dans cette zone. Ces mesures écologiques de réduction des nuisances doivent permettre à la population présente de survivre pendant la durée des travaux et la période de régénération de l’habitat (végétation ligneuse le long des infrastructures autoroutières). Ces mesures faunistiques sont requises conformément au GRUP « Réaménagement spatial du Ring de Bruxelles (R0) – partie Nord » et au titre de l’Arrêté Espèces. La demande de permis pour le réaménagement du R0 Nord Phase 2 zone Zaventem inclut le plan écologique de réduction des nuisances et l’évaluation des espèces. Les parties pertinentes pour ce cahier des charges se trouvent en annexe. Les abattages susmentionnés font partie des travaux préparatoires pour le projet DBFM R0 Nord – Zone Zaventem. Ils font l’objet d’un marché distinct et sont décrits dans la Partie 4 de ce Cahier des charges. Les soumissionnaires sont informés que le Pouvoir adjudicateur recevra en décembre 2025 un avis de l’Institut de Recherche sur la Nature et les Forêts (INBO) concernant l’approche des mesures écologiques de ce cahier des charges. Cet avis sera communiqué aux soumissionnaires par un avis rectificatif – à titre indicatif. La mission concerne 7 sites de capture : 5 à proximité de l’échangeur R0xE19 Machelen et 2 au sud à proximité de l’échangeur R0xE40 Sint-Stevens-Woluwe, où le plus grand nombre possible d’individus doit être capturé. La capture doit être réalisée sur deux années de travail. Les zones écologiques/sites de capture prévus pour une année donnée doivent être vidés au plus tard le 31 août de cette année. Un ou plusieurs sites de relâche doivent être aménagés pour la libération des individus capturés. Le Pouvoir adjudicateur choisit délibérément d’inclure dans un seul cahier des charges les différentes actions relatives à la préparation des sites de relâche, aux captures et au suivi du muscardin, compte tenu des synergies possibles. Les parties intéressées qui n’ont d’expertise que pour l’un des éléments susmentionnés sont invitées à recourir à des sous-traitants ou à se regrouper en consortium pour l’exécution de cette mission. Le cadre juridique applicable comprend le Décret Nature, l’Arrêté Espèces et le formulaire de translocation (ANB). Pendant les travaux, l’Entrepreneur doit respecter les prescriptions définies dans VLAREM I et II.
description-proc.nld: De Opdracht heeft betrekking op het uitvoeren van ecologische maatregelen (zoals o.a. inventarisatie, translocatie en monitoring van bepaalde diersoort), het coördineren van werkzaamheden m.b.t. kappingen en allerhande bijkomende prestaties. De nodige handelingen m.b.t. ecologische minder hindermaatregelen voor de populatie van de soort eikelmuis in het projectgebied van DBFM-project R0 Noord – Zone Zaventem moeten uitgevoerd zijn voorafgaandelijk aan de kappingen en uitvoeringswerken voor de herinrichting van de autosnelweg in dit projectgebied. Deze ecologische minder hindermaatregelen moeten het voor de aanwezige populatie mogelijk maken om de duur van de aanlegwerken en de hergroeiperiode van het leefgebied (houtige beplantingen langs de snelweginfrastructuur) te overleven. Deze minder hinder fauna maatregelen zijn nodig volgens het GRUP ‘Ruimtelijke herinrichting van de Ring rond Brussel (R0) – deel Noord’ en vanuit het Soortenbesluit. In de vergunningsaanvraag voor de herinrichting van de R0 Noord Fase 2 zone Zaventem zijn het minder hinder plan ecologie en de soortentoets opgenomen. De relevante delen voor dit bestek zijn terug te vinden in de bijlage. Voormelde kappingen kaderen in de voorbereidende werken t.b.v. het DBFM-project R0 Noord – Zone Zaventem. Deze zijn voorwerp van een afzonderlijke opdracht en worden nader omschreven in Deel 4 van dit Bestek. Inschrijvers worden erop gewezen dat de Opdrachtgever in de loop van december 2025 een advies zal ontvangen van het Instituut voor Natuur- en Bosonderzoek (INBO) over de aanpak van de ecologische maatregelen van dit bestek. Dit advies zal per terechtwijzend bericht – ten indicatieven titel – worden overgemaakt aan de Inschrijvers. De Opdracht heeft betrekking op 7 afvangstlocaties: 5 in de omgeving van de verkeerswisselaar R0xE19 Machelen, 2 in het zuiden in de omgeving van de verkeerswisselaar R0xE40 Sint-Stevens-Woluwe, waar een zo groot aantal van de aanwezig individuen moeten afgevangen worden. De afvangst dient te gebeuren over twee werkjaren. De ecowerkzones/afvangstlocaties die aan de beurt zijn in een bepaald werkjaar, worden leeggevangen tot ten laatste 31/8 van dat werkjaar. Er dienen een of meerdere doellocaties te worden ingericht voor het loslaten van de gevangen individuen. De Opdrachtgever kiest bewust ervoor om deze verschillende handelingen m.b.t. voorbereidingen doellocaties, de afvangsten en monitoring van eikelmuis in één bestek te voorzien gezien de raakvlakken en de synergie die hierdoor mogelijk zijn. Geïnteresseerde partijen die evenwel enkel expertise hebben t.a.v. één van voornoemde onderdelen worden gewezen op de mogelijkheid beroep te doen op onderaannemers, dan wel zich te verenigen in een consortium voor de uitvoering van deze Opdracht. Het toepasselijk wettelijk kader zijn het Natuurdecreet, het Soortenbesluit, het translocatieformulier (ANB). Gedurende de werken houdt de Opdrachtnemer zich aan de voorschriften zoals deze bepaald zijn in VLAREM I en II.
description-proc.eng: The Assignment concerns the implementation of ecological measures (such as inventory, translocation and monitoring of certain animal species), the coordination of activities related to tree felling, and various additional tasks. The necessary actions regarding ecological mitigation measures for the population of the garden dormouse in the project area of the DBFM project R0 North – Zone Zaventem must be carried out prior to the felling and execution works for the redevelopment of the motorway in this project area. These ecological mitigation measures must enable the existing population to survive the duration of the construction works and the regrowth period of the habitat (woody vegetation along the motorway infrastructure). These fauna mitigation measures are required under the GRUP ‘Spatial redevelopment of the Brussels Ring (R0) – Northern section’ and pursuant to the Species Decree. The permit application for the redevelopment of R0 North Phase 2 Zone Zaventem includes the ecological mitigation plan and the species assessment. The relevant sections for this specification can be found in the annex. The aforementioned felling works form part of the preparatory works for the DBFM project R0 North – Zone Zaventem. These are the subject of a separate contract and are described in Part 4 of these Specifications. Tenderers are informed that the Client will receive an opinion from the Institute for Nature and Forest Research (INBO) in December 2025 regarding the approach to the ecological measures in these specifications. This opinion will be communicated to the tenderers by means of a corrigendum – for information purposes. The Assignment concerns 7 capture locations: 5 near the R0xE19 Machelen interchange, and 2 in the south near the R0xE40 Sint-Stevens-Woluwe interchange, where as many individuals as possible must be captured. The capture must take place over two working years. The eco-work zones/capture locations scheduled for a given year must be cleared by 31 August of that year. One or more release sites must be prepared for releasing the captured individuals. The Client deliberately chooses to include the various actions relating to the preparation of release sites, the captures and monitoring of the garden dormouse in one specification, given the overlaps and synergies this allows. Interested parties that only have expertise in one of the aforementioned components are reminded that they may engage subcontractors or form a consortium for the execution of this Assignment. The applicable legal framework includes the Nature Decree, the Species Decree, and the translocation form (ANB). During the works, the Contractor must comply with the provisions set out in VLAREM I and II.

title-proc.eng: Digital system for registering cleaning and deviations.

description-proc.eng: Background Troms County (TFK) manages buildings of 218,000 m², comprising i.a. schools, sports facilities, dental clinics, workplaces and other county buildings. The cleaning services are carried out by approx. 130 cleaners organised by teams, with a focus on flexible work forms, efficient use of resources and quality in the service delivery. The County municipality needs a more uniform, digital and documentable follow-up of cleaning across buildings, rooms and areas. The current systems do not provide sufficient support for registration and follow-up of work performed, deviations and quality measurements. Therefore there is a need for a system that makes it easy for cleaners to register work and register conditions that affect cleaning, for example rooms that cannot be cleaned, deviations or a lack of periodic cleaning. At the same time, the county needs a better overview and management information. Managers should be able to follow the status per building, area and room, identify areas that have not been cleaned and get a better basis for planning capacity, resource use and absence management. The cleaning quality shall be measured and documented in accordance with NS-INSTA 800. TFK would like systems that provide good support for quality follow-up, reporting and analysis, which contribute to increased user friendliness, better decision making and more efficient operation. The procurement is being made to establish a future orientated digital system that provides a better overview, more uniform practice, better documentation and more efficient management of deviations, quality follow-up and resource planning. Description of the assignment The assignment includes the delivery, establishment, operation and support of a digital cleaning system for Troms County. The system shall provide an overview of cleaning per building, room and area and it can be used by cleaners, substitutes, managers, administrators and operations managers where the work is carried out. The system shall support planning, implementation, documentation and follow-up of the cleaning services. The system shall, among other things: Give easy registration of completed cleaning, status and deviations. Support registration and follow-up of periodic cleaning. Give an overview of rooms and areas that have not been cleaned or where deviations are registered. Support quality measurements and documentation in accordance with NS-INSTA 800. Offer reports and management information that supports follow-up, documentation, analysis and resource planning. Support both short term and long term planning of assignments and resources. Be able to integrate with existing and future MOM systems, as well as facilitate future integrations with other support systems, including possibilities for future use of sensor technology, such as dispensers, waste handling, machines and robots. The delivery shall include the necessary establishment and configuration of the building and room structure, user roles and access management, as well as training, user support and administrative assistance in connection with the introduction and use of the system. TFK would like a user friendly and visually oriented system that facilitates efficient operation, good quality control and future development of the cleaning services. Further requirements for functionality, technical conditions, security, privacy, integrations and service level are stated in the requirement specification.

title-proc.eng: Copenhagen - New Metroline, M5 Civil Works South

description-proc.eng: This tender presents a substantial opportunity for prospective contractors to bid for the M5 Civil Works South (CWS) package, an important component of the Copenhagen metro system's expansion. This project is of significant strategic importance, as the M5 line is a fully automated driverless metro system that will not only enhance passenger service on existing metro corridors but also extend connectivity to emerging urban development areas, including Kløverparken, Refshaleøen, and Lynetteholm in the East Harbour. The M5 is designed to operate as an independent system, ensuring that its construction and subsequent operation do not disrupt the existing M1-M4 metro lines. MAIN COMPONENTS OF THE M5 CIVIL WORK The M5 south consists of approx 6.5 km twin bored TBM tunnels, 5 underground stations (incl. 3 transfer stations), 2 underground crossovers, 1 shaft, 5 cross passages, 1 ramp, approx 2.0 km viaduct, 1 elevated station, 1 viaduct cross-over, 1 elevated bifurcation, short embankment sections. For further details on scope ref. is made to M5-2.1-CMBS-SW and M5-2.2-CWS-SW PHASES: The current tender, Phase 1, encompasses the southern section of the line, from north-west of København H to north of v/Prags Boulevard, with an anticipated operational commencement in 2036. The broader vision includes phase 2 north of v/Prags Boulevard to Lynetteholm opening in 2045 and a potential future extension to form a ring line, signifying a long-term commitment to urban mobility. Phase 2 is not included in this tender. CONTRACT SPLIT OF M5: The M5 project as a whole consists of several contracts: • M5 Civil Works South (this contract) • M5 Transportation System South contract (tendered out as a separate contract in June 2026) • Operation and Maintenance contract (will be tendered out at a later stage) • Enabling Works contracts, e.g. relocation of utilities, relocation works at Kh etc. (enabling works will be tendered out in separate contracts) • Station and Shaft areas (will be tendered out at a later stage) • Canopy contracts (will be tendered out at a later stage). CONTRACT The contract is structured as a design & build contract under ABT18 terms, placing comprehensive responsibility for both design and execution upon the Contractor. This two-phase approach—design followed by execution—is a standard framework for complex infrastructure projects. A market dialogue has been carried out before issuing the tender. The purpose of the market dialogue was to ensure that the project is attractive to the market, and to ensure competitive and compliant final tenders to be used as basis for the award of contract. Metroselskabet I/S is grateful for the potential tenderers who took their time to participate in the dialogue and provided input. INDICATIVE TIMESCHEDULE FOR THE PROCUREMENT Publication of contract notice September 10th 2026. Publication of tender documentation September 11th 2026. Deadline for submission of application for prequalification October 13th 2026, ref. made to section 5.1.12. Dialogue phase November 2026-October 2027. Final tender November 2027. Award of contract December 2027. The time-schedule may be subject to change.
